import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Done — all three hardening fixes are implemented with focused tests, and the repo gate is handed to a monitor for completion.

**What changed (16 files):**
- **Bash/python interpolation (autoquote):** `src/sase/macro/workflow_executor_utils.py` gained `render_bash_template` (every `{{ }}` shell-quoted via `shlex.quote`, `| raw` opt-out) and `render_python_template` (every `{{ }}` rendered as a Python literal via `repr`, `| tojson`/`| raw` passthrough). All four script sinks switched (`workflow_executor_steps_script.py`, `_standalone_steps.py`); prompts/conditions still use unquoted `render_template`. Verified: `$(touch /tmp/pwn)` renders inert, safe tokens byte-identical.
- **Shipped macros:** `json.yml` manual quotes removed (autoquote adds them), `git.yml` `git_ref` word→line (refs contain `/`), `mentor.yml` raw splice replaced with `| tojson` + double `json.loads`. `word`/`agent` inputs tightened to `[A-Za-z0-9._-]+` in `macro/models.py`, keeping the existing error-message contracts.
- **Git refs:** `is_valid_git_revision_name` (mirrors `git check-ref-format --branch` plus leading-dash rejection; cross-checked against real git) filters read-time candidates in `_git_revision_ops.py` and guards `checkout`, `force_checkout`, `recreate_branch_from_remote`, `mail` (plus `--end-of-options`), `diff_revision`, `archive`, `prune`.
- **Agent guard:** `SASE_AGENT_NAME` added to `AGENT_ENV_VARS` in `tools/_sase_install_env.py` (stdlib-only preserved), with a drift-detecting parity test against `agent/identity.py`.

**Tests:** 25 new focused cases (injection marker-file probes, hostile-revision refusals with no git invocation, guard refusals per marker var); 185 + 27 + 13 pass in the directly-affected files.

**Handoff:** `just check` passed all lint gates (ruff, mypy, symvision) and was in its scoped-test lane, so I joined run `7c1299…` to a monitor (`-p verify`) whose follow-up inspects the verdict and closes only `sase-1sb.4` when green (or records a `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP` for base-tree failures). `epic-symbols` is clean.
